about:
Nashville Metal Art & Fabrication operates from Lebanon, Tennessee. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business presents itself as a maker of American-made metal art and outdoor products.

The company produces a line of patriotic metal art including solar-powered garden lights, decorative flags, and collapsible steel fire pits. Products are described as handcrafted in Tennessee and feature designs such as the Heritage Eagle solar light, Pledge of Allegiance flags, and the LIFTED BRO-CO collapsible fire pit. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The brand sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site, targeting patriotic home decor, outdoor living, and military tribute markets. A "Request a Quote" option suggests some custom work, though no B2B industries or OEM customers are identified.

Nashville Metal Art emphasizes domestic production, marketing its goods as "Handcrafted in Tennessee" and "100% Made in the USA." Solar lights ship with pre-installed batteries and require no wiring; fire pits collapse for portability. The stated lead time is four to six weeks.
